versions.changelog: Refreshed every Czech map so duplicated town and village names are now labeled distinctly by district, each at its own location.
Refreshed every Czech map with per-building foundation depth and cleaner water rendering, and reclassified catch-all buildings like warehouses, factories, and schools.
Widened every Czech metro boundary and rendered buildings in true 3D from the RÚIAN cadastre with fuller parks and land use.
Initial release of the České Budějovice map with census-based residents and workers and demand for airports, universities, libraries, hospitals, and attractions.
